svg.title: Yellow Relief
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted. Same-colour vertical panel division is a neutral guide. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of yellow; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-relief-paintings-05-2001/lightbox/works/yellow-relief-1954-55-12580; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
